Container.Name: claude-code-linux
Container.Changes: Rebased on LinuxServer.io's baseimage-selkies: PUID/PGID 99/100 and UMASK work natively, state moves to /config, ports are 3000 (HTTP) and 3001 (HTTPS). This is a fresh start: point AppData at a new, empty folder and sign in to Claude once more.
Container.Overview:
Claude Desktop for Linux (the official Anthropic apt package) and the Claude Code CLI on a Selkies web desktop, streamed to your browser without a VNC client or a local install.
Required first step: the GHCR package is PRIVATE until the redistribution and licensing review is closed. Open the Unraid terminal and run docker login ghcr.io -u YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME pasting a GitHub personal access token with read:packages when prompted. Without this the pull fails with "denied".
Notes: • There is no desktop login. Put the container behind a reverse proxy that authenticates (Pangolin, for example) and point it at port 3000 (HTTP). Never forward 3000 or 3001 to the Internet directly: the session holds your claude.ai and Claude Code credentials. • On the LAN, open the WebUI over HTTPS on port 3001 and accept the self-signed certificate once. Port 3000 opened directly in a browser shows a "requires a secure connection" error. • Everything that must survive an update (Claude Desktop's sign-in, the keyring, the Chrome profile, the CLI's credentials) lives under /config. • Your projects live under /workspaces. Files are written as PUID:PGID with UMASK, so the share stays writable for your other containers. • Run the CLI from the Unraid terminal with: docker exec -it -u abc claude-code-linux claude • Video is encoded on the CPU by default. Add --device=/dev/dri to Extra Parameters for VA-API encoding on an Intel or AMD GPU. • Cowork (the QEMU/KVM feature) is unsupported; the Claude Code CLI ships in the same image. • Updates: GitHub Actions rebuilds the image whenever Anthropic publishes a newer Claude Desktop or Claude Code CLI, and Unraid offers "update ready".

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTPS / Selkies)
Config.Description: HTTPS port of the Selkies WebUI with a self-signed certificate, for use on the LAN; accept the certificate once.

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTP / Selkies)
Config.Description: HTTP port of the Selkies WebUI, for the reverse proxy (Pangolin) that terminates TLS and authenticates in front of the container.

Config.Name: AppData (/config)
Config.Description: Persistent desktop state: Claude Desktop's sign-in and settings, the keyring, the Chrome profile and the Claude Code CLI credentials.

Config.Name: Workspace (/workspaces)
Config.Description: Optional. A host folder with your projects, shown inside the container at /workspaces.

Config.Name: Timezone (TZ)
Config.Description: Container timezone as an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: User ID the desktop runs as. Default 99 (nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for new files. The default 002 keeps them writable for the users group, which suits shares that other containers touch too.
